# Frozen regression fixtures

These records contain only the output portions needed by the card-quality regression suite, based on the project-authored public evaluation corpus. Provider credentials, endpoints and user/device identifiers are excluded. The complete private execution reports are not distributed. Frozen task definitions preserve compatibility tests.

Answers, evidence, failure states and numerical request/token counts are preserved so that the original assertions remain meaningful. These fixtures are regression inputs, not proof of current model accuracy.
